_help: The repos shown in the launcher's repo dropdown. Each entry carries its own method, so the method is chosen here and never in the window: 'bat' clones the repo and runs one of your scripts from the scripts folder, 'copy_and_run' downloads the named files from the repo's newest GitHub release. Entries that share a 'url' share one clone, so a repo with several launch scripts costs one download and one build. See README.md (Repo list) for every field.

repos.name: VIctory
repos.description: Runs the title through the VIctory loader (NVIDIA, 8 GB cards)
repos.instructions:
Pick the folder that holds game_scarlett_master.exe and press Play.
The launcher clones cool_fox, builds it with cargo (the first Play takes a while), and runs Play-VIctory.cmd with VICTORY_GAME_DIR set to your game folder.

repos.name: Victory Belobug
repos.description: AMD fork, built from source and started by its own play script
repos.instructions:
Pick the folder that holds your copy of the title and press Play.
The launcher clones the fork, builds it with cargo (diag profile, the first Play takes a while) and runs scripts\play.ps1 with your title's executable. Needs Rust and the MSVC build tools.

repos.name: Victory Nvidia
repos.description: Prebuilt NVIDIA build, run from inside the game folder
repos.instructions:
Pick the folder that holds game_scarlett_master.exe and press Play.
The launcher downloads victory.exe from the newest release, puts it beside the game and runs it there, then takes it out again when you close the game. Nothing to build.

repos.name: VIctory (4 GB)
repos.description: Same loader, tuned for 4 GB graphics cards
repos.instructions: As VIctory, but runs Play-VIctory-4GB.cmd. Shares the clone and the build with the other VIctory entries.

repos.name: VIctory (AMD)
repos.description: Same loader, tuned for AMD Radeon RX 7000+ with 16 GB or more
repos.instructions: As VIctory, but runs Play-VIctory-AMD.cmd. Shares the clone and the build with the other VIctory entries.
